snippet.title: Tretrais - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
🔥 Tretrais! 🌌

You are stranded on Mars. Your ship is smashed, enemies are knocking on your door every night at 20:00. Tretrias combines the survival and roguelike genre with the brutal nature of Mars.

Collect equipment, craft turrets and stop enemies with unique weapons. Nothing is predictable with randomized events in every playthrough.

You'll feel your breath inside your astronaut helmet and realize that you are truly alone in the dust storms of Mars. Are you ready? Mars is waiting for you!
